title: BBC iPlayer download now installs Beeb
items: The BBC iPlayer tile now downloads Beeb 0.1.6, an independent open-source BBC player not affiliated with or endorsed by the BBC. The catalogue tile keeps its existing name and icon; the installed app is named Beeb.
Live picture, sound and remote controls tested on A5 Pro and XBJ 360. On-demand playback has not yet been verified. Other projector models are untested.
Downloads as one APK, with a separate compatibility build for the 360. Your existing BBC iPlayer installation and login are retained.

title: YouTube single-APK download fixed
items: YouTube 5.30.304 now downloads as one original Google-signed APK, replacing the split package. No merged or re-signed YouTube build is used.
Sign-in and playback tested on A5 Pro and XBJ 360.
If a newer YouTube version is installed, Android may require uninstalling it before installing this compatibility build. This clears app settings and may require signing in again.

title: Channel 4 TV app available for all projector selections
items: The single-file Channel 4 Android TV app is now available in Live TV for every projector selection. Requires Android 8 or later.
Picture, sound and remote navigation confirmed on A5 Pro and XBJ 360. Other models have not been tested.
Uninstall an older Channel 4 build if Android reports a signature conflict, then install this APK and sign in again.

title: Channel 4 TV app for A5 Pro
items: Channel 4 now uses the Android TV interface on A5 Pro, replacing the mobile build that showed a Google Play services warning.
Downloads as one APK. Sign-in, picture, sound and remote navigation tested on A5 Pro.
Uninstall the previous Channel 4 app before installing this version, then sign in again. HDMI/capture playback compatibility has not been verified.

title: Projector Guy 2.11.2 — installer update
items: Added a Projector install option when Android cannot install an app’s split APK files. Tested with the original Google-signed YouTube on A5 Pro.
The fallback requires debugging enabled and one-time approval of Projector Guy’s connection. Existing app data is kept.
Downloads now show one overall progress percentage, and failed installs retain their files for retry.

title: Live TV guide added
items: TellyGrid Live TV Guide is now available in the Live TV section, alongside BBC iPlayer, Channel 4 and My5.

title: Original A5 Pro YouTube restored
items: YouTube now offers the original A5 Pro 5.30.304 build, with Google’s original signature.
This replaces the newer 360 build in the catalogue.

title: Disney+ installation update
items: Disney+ 26.19 now downloads as one APK, replacing the split installer that failed on the A5 Pro.
If Android reports a signature conflict, uninstall your existing Disney+ first and install again. You will need to sign in again.

title: Disney+, Netflix and STV updates
items: Disney+ updated to 26.19.0 — picture, sound and remote navigation confirmed on A5 Pro. Requires Android 12L or later.
Netflix 9.88.0 build 7 is now available for A5 Pro.
STV Player updated to TV build 1.8.14.2 — picture, sound and remote navigation confirmed on A5 Pro. Requires Android 12L or later.
Disney+ and STV may require uninstalling your existing version first, then signing in again.

title: XBJ Remote Control added
items: New Remote Control page — control your XBJ projector from the Projector Guy app
Full D-pad navigation with power, menu, and OK buttons
Quick-access hotkeys for Netflix, YouTube, Hulu and Disney+
Volume and focus controls, plus playback buttons
Automatic projector discovery on your local network
Works with the native Projector Guy app — just tap Remote in the sidebar

title: Split APK support & new streaming apps
items: Added ITV Mobile Player 17.17.0 with full split APK support — now installs smoothly on all devices
Updated STV Player 4.43.0.1 with split APK support for better compatibility
Updated BBC iPlayer to Nvidia Shield Partners version with new official BBC iPlayer logo
Added automatic split APK handling in the store — download and install multiple APK files in one go

title: New TV-style app store design
items: Redesigned the whole store into a TV-style layout — a side menu plus big poster-style cards, instead of the old top-tab layout
Added AK47 Sports, MovieBox and HD Streamz to Entertainment
Added a "Change Projector" option in the sidebar to quickly switch models without digging into Preferences
Entertainment now stays unlocked for 30 minutes after entering the code, instead of just 2
The Entertainment lock icon now shows amber while locked and turns green and open the moment it's unlocked, everywhere it appears
Fixed the sign-in screen so the on-screen keyboard no longer covers the username/code fields

title: Generate your own Entertainment code
items: The Entertainment unlock screen now has a "Generate my code" button — get instant access without messaging us, no need to wait for a reply
Self-generated codes are valid for 60 seconds, so they can't be shared around after the fact

title: Install all Live TV apps in one go
items: The Live TV section now has an "Install all" button — installs BBC iPlayer, ITVX, Channel 4 and My5 one after another instead of finding and installing each one yourself

title: New app added and updates
items: Added STV Player to Live TV
Added LinkDrop to Tools in Entertainment
Updated Channel 4 to the latest version
Fixed an issue where MovieBox could fail to install on some projectors
